correctness.rationale: Constructed CTMC on infected subsets with rate alpha+beta sum_{infected neighbor u}1/deg(u) to infect susceptible v, recovery rate 1. Quotient generator by automorphism orbits (6 for C4, 9 for diamond), solve stationary linear equations symbolically. Difference is -alpha beta²F(alpha,beta)/(UV) with U,V positive-coefficient polynomials and beta degree-8 numerator F. Coefficients c0..c4 each have exactly one positive alpha root r4<r3<r2<r1<r0=7/8; c5..c8 positive. Thus for alpha>=7/8 F>0; for lower alpha coefficient signs have exactly one negative-to-positive change giving unique positive beta root by Descartes and endpoint signs. For connected n<=3 only possible edge addition P3->K3 has exact positive prevalence difference. Independent 16-state stationary-generator solver confirms 8 parameter/graph checks, including negative difference at alpha=beta=1 and smaller-n cases. Full universal sign proof uses exact polynomial and rational sign brackets in inspected verify.py, not numerical sampling.
residual_risks: Unbounded alpha,beta conclusion depends on the exact generated numerator/denominator polynomial identity and Descartes sign proof; independent finite spot checks alone do not establish it.
Rate model is per-infected-source normalized by source degree; standard per-edge constant transmission lacks this edge-reallocation mechanism.
